column2: ChiTonga–English Bible glosses, machine-made by word-aligning five ChiTonga Bibles (the Chitonga Bible, the Toka-Leya, Bbaibele 1996, Ibbaibele 1963, the Tonga Translation Project) with 7 English ones (ASV, BBE, BSB, ERV, KJV, ULB, WEB) and nine children's stories in ChiTonga (the Zambia Storybook Corpus, two translations) with eflomal: a ChiTonga word's English glosses and an English word's ChiTonga ones, commonest first. A word only the stories have, or (English) only the KJV and ASV, has its name after it. Unchecked: verify before relying on it.
